mission_08: Sometimes you need to scale data to a specific range other than [0, 1]. For example, sensor readings might need to be scaled to [0, 100] for percentage display, or model outputs might need to be scaled to [-1, 1] for certain activation functions. In this mission, you will learn to scale data to arbitrary ranges using both sklearn's MinMaxScaler with the feature_range parameter and manual implementation of the generalized formula: new_x = (x - min) / (max - min) * (new_max - new_min) + new_min. This flexibility is essential when integrating with systems that expect specific value ranges.
